decision_rule: Held-out fit quality at the final checkpoint (step143000), pooled over the seven wrap widths 20 to 140, at that checkpoint's own best readout, must lie within 0.02 of the committed 0.781031. Outside that band is VOID_ANCHOR_FAILED: an instrument fault that voids the whole sweep, stops the run, and is not evidence about the model. The band is tighter than any fresh-text band because this is the same text, the same instrument and the same model as the committed value.
metric: Held-out pooled quality at the final checkpoint, on the same text as the committed 0.781031, at that checkpoint's own best readout.
notes: This is the same text, the same instrument and the same model as the committed value, so the band is tighter than any fresh-text band would be. The four-part profile at this checkpoint also closes a known evidence gap: no in-distribution profile had ever been measured on this 410-million-weight model, whatever it shows. The boundary ratio is the mean of the profile's first two parts minus the mean of its last two. It reads about 0.5 on the larger 1.4-billion-weight model, which is where the presence threshold of 0.3 comes from. A ratio below 0.3 at the final checkpoint records the boundary as absent there, leaves every quality reading standing, and moves the boundary question to a future run on the larger model. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
